vehicleDetails.title: Sierra
vehicleDetails.description: The all-new Tata Sierra EV redefines the electric SUV segment, launching at ₹18.79 lakh with an uncompromising range of up to 665 km (MIDC) and a powerful dual-motor 4WD system capable of a 0-100 km/h sprint in just 5.8 seconds. Built on the advanced acti.ev platform, the vehicle offers exceptional practicality with 622 litres of boot space and a 55-litre frunk, paired with an Ultra Glide 5-link suspension system for superior ride comfort. Tech-savvy drivers will appreciate the Level 2+ ADAS capabilities, including Auto Park and 540-degree view, alongside a segment-first soundbar-mode audio system with JBL and Dolby Atmos. With 120 kW DC fast charging that provides 250+ km of range in just 15 minutes, the Sierra EV is the ultimate blend of sustainable performance, cutting-edge connectivity, and rugged versatility.

variantData.title: Sierra EV Pure 63 kWh
variantData.description:
The Tata Sierra EV Pure 63 delivers a balanced fusion of performance and utility, anchored by a high-capacity 63 kWh battery architecture. This configuration provides a substantial driving range of 566 km, ensuring long-distance capability for both city commuting and highway touring. Supporting its electric powertrain is an efficient charging ecosystem, capable of rapid replenishment via a 110kW DC fast charger, which brings the battery from 20% to 80% in approximately 25 minutes. Users also benefit from versatile charging options, including a 7.2 kW AC wall box, making home and office charging seamless.

Beyond its mechanical prowess, the vehicle is designed as a tech-forward SUV. The cabin is centered around a 12.3-inch touchscreen infotainment system that integrates advanced navigation with live traffic updates, ensuring precise route planning and real-time guidance. The experience is further elevated by the iRA.ev connected car suite, which enables remote vehicle status checks, remote AC control, and over-the-air (OTA) updates. Safety and convenience are prioritized through a comprehensive feature set, including 6 airbags, an electronic stability program, and a sophisticated ADAS suite—featuring lane departure warnings, autonomous parking, and blind-spot monitoring. With a 205 mm ground clearance and a spacious 622-liter boot, the Sierra EV Pure 63 RWD is engineered to handle diverse Indian road conditions while maintaining the comfort and connectivity expected in a premium electric SUV.

variantData.title: Sierra EV Adventure 63 kWh
variantData.description: The Tata Sierra EV Adventure 63 kWh stands as a pinnacle of modern electric SUV design, blending the legendary rugged legacy of the Sierra nameplate with advanced, performance-oriented electrification. At its core, the vehicle is driven by a high-capacity 63 kWh battery pack, engineered to deliver exceptional range and consistent power delivery for long-distance journeys and demanding adventures alike. To ensure unparalleled control across diverse environments, the Adventure variant features a sophisticated terrain-response system offering four distinct drive modes—Normal, Wet, Rough, and Custom—which precisely calibrate throttle response, torque distribution, and traction control to match specific ground conditions. The cabin experience is equally refined, focusing on both luxury and practical utility; drivers benefit from immersive ambient interior lighting that creates a premium atmosphere, complemented by a dedicated, high-intensity boot lamp that provides critical visibility for cargo management during nighttime excursions or remote camping trips. Coupled with its robust structural integrity, state-of-the-art electric powertrain efficiency, and thoughtful interior enhancements, the Tata Sierra EV Adventure 63 kWh is meticulously crafted to satisfy the needs of adventure-seeking enthusiasts who demand a versatile, reliable, and technologically advanced electric vehicle capable of mastering both urban commutes and challenging off-road trails.
